However, autoregressive vision-language models generate these plans one coordinate token at a time, making richer predictions increasingly costly. analysis.detail_brief: Models for physical AI tasks, such as robotics and autonomous driving, need not reason solely in language. We introduce VFlash, a method for fast, accurate visual planning through Flash Primitive Decoding.
